pattern: percentage-point change between two labelled rounds on messy headers, state filter, detail rows only
question: NFHS-5 minus NFHS-4 fully vaccinated percent for every Bihar district, don't include the state total row
gold_sql: SELECT "District", MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) - MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" END) AS change_pp FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "State" = 'Bihar' AND "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: SELECT d5.District, d5."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" - d4."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS "NFHS-5 minus NFHS-4 fully vaccinated percent" FROM "district_health_factsheet" AS d5 JOIN "district_health_factsheet" AS d4 ON d5.District = d4.District AND d5.State = d4.State WHERE d5.State = 'Bihar' AND d5."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' AND d4."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' AND d5.District <> 'State Total'

NFHS-5 minus NFHS-4 fully vaccinated percent for every Bihar district, don't include the state total row
attempts.response:
SELECT
  d5.District,
  d5."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" - d4."Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS "NFHS-5 minus NFHS-4 fully vaccinated percent"
FROM "district_health_factsheet" d5
JOIN "district_health_factsheet" d4
  ON d5.District = d4.District
  AND d5.State = d4.State
WHERE d5.State = 'Bihar'
  AND d5."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
  AND d4."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
  AND d5.District != 'State Total';
